# Visualize

> Visualize is an executive and operational continuous business intelligence & KPI tracking platform. It allows teams to organize metrics across hierarchical collaborative Rooms, build AI-assisted metric formulas, integrate multiple data sources, and monitor telemetry in real-time.

## Key Capabilities

- **KPI Tracking & Telemetry**: Define quantitative metrics across custom intervals (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly). Track progress against targets, historical performance, and variance.
- **Hierarchical Rooms & Pods**: Organize metrics and KPIs across departments, teams, and collaborative sub-spaces with macOS-style frosted glass desktop folders and tag categorization.
- **AI Metric Builder**: Natural language metric definition powered by Google Gemini that generates complex formulas, benchmarks, and data schemas automatically.
- **Multi-Source Data Ingestion**: Direct REST API entry logging, Google Sheets and Zoho CRM connectors, and universal CSV/Excel spreadsheets importer.
- **Multi-Tenant Security**: Role-based access control (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer), organization workspaces, and tokenized authorization.

## Core Data Concepts

- **Room**: A collaborative workspace representing a department, pod, or objective containing focused metrics.
- **KPI**: A specific measurable indicator with target values, aggregation rules (sum, average, max, min, latest), and display formats (currency, percentage, number).
- **DataField**: An underlying data variable or ingested metric column.
- **Entry**: A periodic timestamped recorded value for a DataField or KPI.
